name: Like Kind Exchange Calculator
meta_title: Like-Kind Exchange Calculator for Multiple Properties
meta_description: Combine up to three properties sold and four bought in one like-kind exchange. See the gain deferred, the boot taxed now and each new property’s basis.
subtitle: Combine several properties sold and bought in one like-kind exchange to see the total gain deferred, any boot taxed now, and how the carryover basis splits among the replacement properties.

Gain on each property you give up

Exchange costs (selling and purchase) are shared out in proportion to sale price, so the gains add up to the total realized gain.

PropertySale priceAdjusted basisShare of costsGain realized

Basis of each replacement property

The carryover basis is split among the replacement properties in proportion to their purchase prices. Built-in deferred gain is what would be taxed if you later sold a property for its purchase price.

PropertyPurchase priceShare of valueBasisBuilt-in deferred gainYour equity

Each property’s basis still has to be split between land and building for depreciation, usually by the ratio on the property tax assessment.
